description: This file implements the GatewayDiscovery class in Kotlin that manages network service discovery for gateways using multiple protocols such as mDNS (via NsdManager), DNS SRV, and TXT records. It handles local and wide-area discovery, resolves service information, and maintains a list of available gateways.

classes.name: GatewayDiscovery
classes.description: Manages network gateway discovery via mDNS and DNS queries, resolves services, and maintains current list of gateways.

methods.name: startLocalDiscovery
methods.description: Initiates local network service discovery using NsdManager.

methods.name: stopLocalDiscovery
methods.description: Stops ongoing local network service discovery.

methods.name: startUnicastDiscovery
methods.description: Begins wide-area network discovery by periodically querying DNS records.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a discovered network service to retrieve detailed info and updates internal state.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Updates the observable list of gateways with current discovered endpoints.

methods.name: buildStatusText
methods.description: Generates a status message summarizing current discovery state.

methods.name: stableId
methods.description: Constructs a consistent identifier for a service based on name and domain.
